visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a white t-shirt and a black-and-white patterned neckerchief holds a camera for a selfie-style vlog. He is outdoors on an urban sidewalk with a middle-aged woman in a green pleated top. They are smiling and talking. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a brightly lit, modern retail store with floor-to-ceiling glass windows. The woman is seen examining various electronic devices, including smartwatches on display stands and a pink-colored smartphone. The lighting is crisp and white. (3) The woman handles a pink iPhone 16 Plus, showing its side buttons and screen to the camera. She and the young man take a selfie together in the store's reflection. (4) The setting shifts to a restaurant with warm indoor lighting and wooden furniture. An older man is seated at a table. A hand presents a white shopping bag with a grey logo to him. (5) The man opens the bag to reveal a smartphone box. Two younger individuals are seated next to him, all looking on with smiles. The man takes the phone out of the box and examines it. The final shot shows the three of them posing for a happy group photo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-arousal female and male voices speaking in Mandarin. A light, upbeat lo-fi pop beat plays continuously. Faint outdoor traffic hum is audible. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. The female voice continues with high pitch variability, discussing shopping plans. (3) A 'ding' sound effect highlights a specific point in the conversation inside the store. Sounds of shoes on hard floors are present. (4) Another 'whoosh' sound effect as the setting changes. The rustling of a paper shopping bag is heard clearly over the music. (5) A light percussive thud as a cardboard box is placed on a wooden table. Multiple voices overlap in celebration, shouting 'Happy Father's Day' with joyful valence. (6) Laughter and high-pitched reactions follow the box opening. The music swells slightly in volume during the climax of the surprise.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document a son and mother purchasing a high-end smartphone as a Father's Day gift and capturing the father's surprised and happy reaction during a family dinner.
